newsitem.title: THAILAND: Bangkok Bank approves $1.5 bln bond issue.
newsitem.headline: Bangkok Bank approves $1.5 bln bond issue.

text.p: Thailand's largest commercial bank Bangkok Bank Plc said on Thursday its shareholders had approved its plan to issue the first $1.5 billion tranche of a total $3.0 billion issue of various types of bonds in foreign currencies.

The first tranche of bond which received shareholders' approval will be issued in various forms, including subordinate and perpetual bonds, Bangkok Bank said in a statement to the Stock Exchange of Thailand.
The bank said the subordinate bonds would have a maturity of no more than 100 years, while other types of bond could be redeemed in 50 years.

The bank's board would work out further details and conditions of the first tranche of bond issue later, it said.
Bangkok Bank said earlier last month the second tranche, also valued up to $1.5 billion, would be issued as ordinary bonds and subordinate bonds under the bank's medium-term note programme.
The bonds in the second tranche would have a 30-year maturity, the bank said.
